prompt:
Here is the transcript of our planning call. Summarize this meeting.

Riverside Library Volunteer Fair: planning call
Tuesday, October 6, 2026, 6:00 pm. Present: Maya (chair), Leo, Priya, Sam, Grace.

[00:00] Maya: Okay, thanks for joining. We have four things: the hall, flyers, food, and the budget. Let's keep it to fifteen minutes.
[00:12] Maya: First, the hall. Leo, you know the community center people.
[00:18] Leo: Yeah. I'll book the community hall by Friday. They want a deposit, but the library covers that.
[00:29] Maya: Great. And the date. I was thinking Saturday the 24th.
[00:35] Grace: The 24th works for me.
[00:38] Sam: Same.
[00:41] Leo: Hang on. I don't know if the hall is free that day. Can we not lock the date until I've talked to them?
[00:49] Maya: Fair. Let's not decide the date today. We'll wait for the hall.
[00:55] Maya: Flyers. Priya, you did the lovely ones last spring.
[01:02] Priya: I could maybe do the flyers, but I'm swamped until next week. Let me check and get back to you.
[01:10] Maya: No pressure. Let us know.
[01:13] Maya: Food. Grace?
[01:16] Grace: I'll call the caterer by Wednesday and ask about sandwiches for about sixty people.
[01:24] Sam: Sixty sounds right. Last year we ran out.
[01:28] Maya: Okay. And we need a sign-up sheet for volunteers.
[01:33] Sam: I'll set up the sign-up form. An online one, so people can pick time slots.
[01:40] Maya: Perfect.
[01:42] Maya: Budget. Someone needs to send the budget to the board before their meeting.
[01:48] Sam: Not me, I did it last time.
[01:51] Leo: I'm doing the hall, that's my thing.
[01:54] Maya: Right. We'll figure that out.
[01:57] Maya: Oh, and it would be nice if someone posted about the fair on the library's page.
[02:03] Grace: Mm.
[02:05] Maya: Anything else on food?
[02:07] Grace: Actually, wait. I'm away all of Wednesday and Thursday for work. Sam, could you take the caterer call instead?
[02:15] Sam: Sure. I'll call them Thursday.
[02:18] Grace: Thank you. Ask for vegetarian options too.
[02:22] Sam: Will do.
[02:24] Maya: Good. So, quick round. Anything else?
[02:27] Priya: Just that I'll know about the flyers by Monday.
[02:31] Maya: Great. Thanks, everyone. Same time next week.
